gorwath_done.m: Thanks again for your great help!

gorwath_exit.m: I will go now and prepare a present for lovely Arensia. When we get married, you will of course be invited.

gorwath_exit_1.m: Before we go our separate ways, please take this ring that I found behind those haystacks over there.

r: I am not Andor. What do you want from him?

gorwath_letter_1.m: Oh, Andor promised to meet me here. Who are you?
r: My name is $playername. I'm looking for my brother too, he has been away for a while now.
My name is none of your business. Get out of our property now!

gorwath_letter_10.m: You probably don't know me. I am Gorwath. I only recently moved to Crossglen to live with my aunt.

gorwath_letter_11.m: Yes. You know her? Then you will also know how strict she can be. Sigh.

gorwath_letter_12.m: I met someone at the last weekly market and I want to send them something.

gorwath_letter_13.m: To be precise, I have a letter ... for ... a lovely girl.

gorwath_letter_14.m: Yes, she is the most beautiful girl in the world! Her name is Arensia.
r: Hm, I don't know anyone here by that name.

gorwath_letter_15.m: Unfortunately she lives in Fallhaven. My aunt would never allow me to go there.
r: And how could I help you?

gorwath_letter_16.m: Andor promised to take the letter to her. Maybe you could ...

gorwath_letter_2.m: Oh dear, oh dear. This is a very personal matter. I don't want everyone to know about it.
r: I want to help you since my brother did not. Please tell me what's on your mind.
I promise not to tell anyone.

gorwath_letter_20.m: Would you be so kind to give her my letter?

gorwath_letter_22.m: You really don't want to help me? Then I have no more hope.
r: Now, now. Give me your precious letter, I'll do it.
Sorry, but I have no time. I have to find my brother now.
Grow up and solve your problems yourself. I'm not a postman!

gorwath_letter_24.m:
Good by then. I will not disturb you anymore.
* Sob *

gorwath_letter_3.m: Really? That's very kind of you.

gorwath_letter_50.m: Thanks a lot. Here's the letter. Go to Fallhaven and look for Arensia.
r: Fallhaven is a big city. How shall I find her?

gorwath_letter_52.m: She is the daughter of Jakrar the woodcutter, so she will surely live there.

gorwath_love.m: You are back! Did you find Arensia?
r: Yes. I gave her the letter and she asked me to tell you that she loves you too.

gorwath_love_2.m: You have truly earned these gold pieces.

gorwath_tmp.m: Did you give her the letter yet?
r: Eh ... no. I thought, it wasn't that important.

gorwath_tmp2.m: Not that important?? I can barely breathe if I don't get her answer! Hurry now! Please, do.

postman.10: Gorwath would like me to give a letter to Arensia, in Fallhaven.
postman.12: But I decided not to help him with that.
postman.20: I gave the letter to Arensia, who was visibly happy about it. Gorwath needs to hear that.
postman.30: I told Gorwath that I gave the letter to Arensia. He's happy too.

sk.fightstyleUnarmedUnarmored: Fighting style: Way of the monk
